messages:
community-bot: Hey @channel — rolling out Community Contrib Cookbook v1.1 today. Focus: plug-and-play connectors, small transform examples, and expanded eval prompts. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-contrib-cookbook :rocket:

alexa: sweet. what's changed from v1.0?

community-bot: Short list: 1) new connectors for S3/MinIO and simple DB adapters 2) standardized `stability/*` labels for maturity (alpha/beta/prod-ready) 3) an integrations checklist for Dedicated/Private (deploy_checklist.md) 4) faster CI for minimal evals. Full changelog in RELEASE_NOTES.md.

joana: Maintainers: note the new triage flow. When a PR lands add one `stability/*` label + one `scope/*` label. We're trialing a 48-hour triage SLA for the core cookbook repos. Also: maintainer sync Thurs 9am PT to run through labeling and the new CI fast-path.

matt: Added a tutorial recipe for on-device quant flags (recipes/on-device-quant). Quick datapoint: on aultra-32 (arm64) with powertune flags, INT8 gave ~1.8x throughput at 384 seq with negligible BLEU drop on our demo eval. Details and plots in the recipe.

samir: Marketplace question: will items labelled `prod-ready` be considered for the plugin marketplace automatically, or is there a separate vetting?

alexa: Not automatic. Prod-ready is a precondition for ops/product review. We'll collect candidate contribs in the /marketplace-candidates file and ops will reach out for the marketplace checklist.

rajesh: CI update: lightweight eval job runs on PRs using a cached model layer to cut runtime. If you see flakes, add `ci/retry` to the PR or ping infra. Also added a smoke test that runs the connector create flow. Expect some initial failures until maintainers add required env samples.

joana: Hosting a 45-min office hours / walkthrough for new contributors this Fri 11am PT — we'll demo connector scaffolding and the eval harness. Sign-up: https://calendar.redwood.ai/cookbook/onboarding-v1-1. :coffee:

community-bot: Release tag: v1.1.0. Direct link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-contrib-cookbook/releases/tag/v1.1.0. Thanks to the contributors and CI/infra folks for getting the fast-path landed. Please help triage the first wave of PRs. :tada:
